subject: Signature platform transition playbook
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11 09:12 -0700
Subject: Signature platform transition playbook

Team,

We need a short, executable playbook for consolidating our contract signing tooling. The ask:
- One-page mutual action plan (MAP) showing milestones through production cutover.
- Risk matrix for data migration, SSO, and e-delivery (retention and audit logs).
- Procurement checklist and preferred negotiation levers (credits, termination windows, transition support).

Context: Legal has flagged overlapping CLM features and multiple e-sign vendors are increasing cost and complexity. I want us to run a parallel evaluation (Ironclad + DocuSign) but land on a single platform for standard templates and integration simplicity.

Please draft the MAP and checklist by EOD Monday so we can share with vendors ahead of next week’s demos. I’ll coordinate a vendor-side conversation once we have the internal plan.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Procurement (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11 10:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Signature platform transition playbook

Thanks, Tessa — good call. I attached a working procurement checklist (transition-checklist.xlsx) that maps out contractual, security, and implementation criteria we should score for each vendor. High-level notes:

- Procurement priorities: 18-month TCO target, clear rollback terms, and migration assistance included in SOW.
- Legal priorities: vendor must provide exportable audit logs and a bounded retention policy for archived documents.
- Implementation: verify SS0, SCIM/user provisioning, and template migration tooling.

I’ll convert the checklist into a one-page MAP and send a draft by Monday noon. Can Markus confirm budget envelope to make pricing tradeoffs (credits vs up-front discounts)?

-Marissa
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: transition-checklist.xlsx (procurement scoring template)
From: Alex Hart <alex.hart@ironclad.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12 08:45 -0700
Subject: Ironclad — draft SOW and suggested MAP

Hi Tessa / Marissa / team,

Appreciate the heads-up — attaching a draft SOW and a suggested mutual action plan that mirrors the milestones you outlined. Quick highlights based on your checklist:

- We can provide a 90-day migration engagement (templates + automated mapping) and a 6-month support window post-cutover.
- Audit logs export available in JSON and CSV; we’ll include a KMS integration addendum for enterprise key management.
- Pricing: pilot discount available for first 3 months; we’ll include uplift for advanced analytics as an optional line item.

I copied the IO for our solutions engineering team who will join the technical demo. Happy to update the MAP once you share your internal scoring.

Best,
Alex Hart
Enterprise Sales
Ironclad

Attachment: Ironclad-draft-sow.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: sales@docusign.com
Date: 2026-10-12 12:05 -0700
Subject: RE: Signature platform transition playbook

Tessa / Marissa — quick finance note: we need a target 18-month cost model to compare vendor TCOs side-by-side. I don’t want to over-index on sticker price; credits and multi-year commit trade-offs should be modeled.

Also: let’s keep DocuSign in the mix for parity on e-notary and envelope-level SLAs. Please include a column in the checklist for: migration assistance cost, template fidelity risk, and SLA credits.

Markus
VP Finance
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-10-13 09:00 -0700
Subject: Signature platform transition playbook — draft and vendor sync

Team — attaching the first draft of the playbook (playbook-draft.pdf). I’ve also scheduled a 60-minute vendor sync for next Wednesday 11/18 at 10am PT with Ironclad and DocuSign; calendar invites are out.

Immediate asks:
- Marissa: please finalize the MAP in the playbook with scoring columns completed.
- Markus: please confirm the 18-month budget envelope so we can share a topline with vendors.
- Neha: coordinate security questionnaire items we want to surface in the initial RFP.

If we can get the MAP and budget by Tuesday EOD, we’ll use the Wednesday vendor sync for technical Q&A and to lock down an implementation timeline.

Thanks — will track actions in the shared Drive.

—Tessa
Head of Procurement (acting)
Redwood Inference
